page_title: BAY 4-2 HEI | Bayern Munich v Heidenheim 07/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+2' Vincent Kompany has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) replacing Raphael Guerreiro.
90+2' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Arijon Ibrahimovic (Bayern Munich) comes onto the pitch so that Kingsley Coman can be given a rest.

90+1' 4 - 2 Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Kevin Muller is just a bystander as the ball flies into the bottom left corner. The score is 4:2.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
87' A yellow card for a tackle by Daniel Peretz (Bayern Munich). Soren Storks doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
87' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Soren Storks to decide it wasn’t offside. The relieved Heidenheim players can finally celebrate.
87' The Heidenheim players halt their celebrations as referee Soren Storks makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
85' 3 - 2 Goal - 3:2! Leo Scienza tees up Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Daniel Peretz.

84' 3 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) fires a brilliant volley low into the middle of the net from the edge of the box, leaving the goalkeeper helpless. Leroy Sane provided the assist. What a finish! 3:1.
83' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 19:1.
80' Bayern Munich are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
79' The manager makes a subsitution with Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) coming on for Mathias Honsak.
78' Frank Schmidt has decided to make a change. Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) replaces Benedikt Gimber.
77' 84:16 – this is the current ball possession ratio.

74' Kevin Muller pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the middle of the goal, but was stopped by the goalkeeper.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) replaces Jan Schoppner.
71' Here is a change. Michael Olise is going off and Vincent Kompany gives the last tactical orders to Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich).
71' Substitution. Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) has come on for Aleksandar Pavlovic.

71' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) receives the ball and has a go from distance, but he shouldn't have bothered as it sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
70' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) plays a one-two with Raphael Guerreiro, but the move breaks down.
69' Wonderful movement by Bayern Munich. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
67' Maximilian Breunig (Heidenheim) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
65' The referee signals a substitution. Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) is brought on as a substitute for Paul Wanner.
64' Frank Schmidt prepares a substitution. Luca Kerber is replaced by Maximilian Breunig (Heidenheim).
64' Soren Storks blows for a foul after Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
64' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends a long ball in, but Kevin Muller comfortably gathers the ball.
62' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.

62' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick shot to the roof of the net, but he can't get the power to direct it past Kevin Muller, who keeps it out. Bayern Munich force their opponents to concede a corner.
60' A pass by Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
58' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 6:1.
56' 2 - 1 Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom left corner.
55' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
53' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
51' Here comes a substitution. Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) is brought on as a substitute for Thomas Muller.

50' 1 - 1 Goal! The ball breaks to Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) after some poor defending, he finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and calmly puts the ball into the back of the net! He makes it 1:1.
50' Bayern Munich take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
50' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The ball is out of play. Bayern Munich win a corner kick.
49' Bayern Munich quickly take the free kick with a short pass.
49' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) is penalised for holding. Soren Storks signals a set piece. Free kick. Bayern Munich will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
47' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+1' Soren Storks blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) receives a neat pass inside the box with his back to goal, swivels and hits a powerful shot that goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
42' The resulting set piece from Bayern Munich is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

42' Bayern Munich are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bayern Munich.
41' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) will take a corner kick.

39' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the left post. Unlucky! The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
37' Bayern Munich are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
35' Kevin Muller makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) after a cross from the side.
34' Bayern Munich take a short corner kick.

34' Bayern Munich show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. The linesman points to the corner flag, Bayern Munich are going to take it.

33' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
31' Kevin Muller is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Michael Olise (Bayern Munich). Easy save!

30' Bayern Munich slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
27' Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.
27' Bayern Munich have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
27' A cross into the box from Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) is cleared. Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

25' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Heidenheim, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
23' Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball has crossed the sideline. Bayern Munich are taking a throw-in.

20' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Bayern Munich are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.

18' 1 - 0 Goal! Joshua Kimmich launched the corner kick and superbly found the head of Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich), whose accurate effort from near the penalty spot went straight into the left side of the goal. It's 1:0.
18' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) will take the corner.

18' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.

15' Chance! Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Michael Olise, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.

14' What a chance that is! Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes well wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.

13' A neat pass is well received by Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the middle of the target. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
12' Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Soren Storks blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Bayern Munich.
10' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The ball is behind the touchline and Bayern Munich will take a throw-in.
9' Bayern Munich are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in. It's a throw-in for Bayern Munich.
6' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Soren Storks has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Heidenheim earn a free kick.

5' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) receives a clever long through ball and finds himself in a promising position inside the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and clears. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
2' Bayern Munich seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Heidenheim will have the kick-off.
Soren Storks will supervise the game today.
